settings.title: HVAC Service Areas in Des Moines & Central Iowa

settings.editor:
When you need heating, cooling, or indoor comfort service, location matters. You want a local HVAC team that understands Central Iowa homes, knows the weather, and can tell you clearly whether your area is covered.

Lenz Heating & Cooling provides HVAC repair, replacement, maintenance, indoor air quality, ductwork, water heater, and related home comfort services throughout the Des Moines metro and surrounding Central Iowa communities. With our Urbandale main office and Waukee location, our team is positioned to serve homeowners across established neighborhoods, growing suburbs, and nearby communities with dependable service and clear communication.

Whether you need AC repair in Des Moines, furnace service in Urbandale, HVAC maintenance in Waukee, or indoor air quality help in a surrounding community, our local team is here to help you get comfortable again.

settings.title: Reliable HVAC Services Available Where You Live

settings.editor: No matter which part of the Des Moines metro you call home, Lenz Heating & Cooling provides a full range of HVAC and home comfort services designed for Central Iowa weather. From humid summer afternoons to freezing winter nights, our team helps homeowners keep their systems safe, efficient, and reliable.

Central Iowa summers can put your cooling system under serious strain. Lenz Heating & Cooling provides AC repair, AC maintenance, AC replacement, and AC installation for homes throughout the Des Moines metro and nearby communities.

Whether your air conditioner is leaking water, blowing warm air, freezing up, running constantly, or no longer keeping your home comfortable, our team can inspect the system and explain your options clearly.

settings.html: Explore Air Conditioning Services

settings.html: Built for Central Iowa

settings.title: Local HVAC Service Built for Central Iowa Homes

settings.editor:
Every home has its own comfort challenges. That is especially true across Central Iowa, where older homes, newer construction, changing neighborhoods, and extreme seasonal weather can all affect HVAC performance.

In established Des Moines-area neighborhoods, homes may have older ductwork, aging equipment, airflow concerns, or heating and cooling systems that no longer match the way the home is used. In newer communities around Waukee, Grimes, Ankeny, and West Des Moines, homeowners may need help with system sizing, humidity control, smart thermostats, indoor air quality, or routine maintenance to keep newer equipment running well.

Central Iowa weather adds another layer. Hot, humid summers can make an undersized or poorly maintained AC struggle. Cold winter nights can expose furnace issues quickly. Dust, pollen, cottonwood, and seasonal humidity can also affect airflow and indoor air quality.

That is why Lenz Heating & Cooling looks at more than the equipment alone. Our technicians consider your system, home layout, airflow, comfort concerns, and budget before recommending the next step.
